caption: This shio ramen features a clear, golden broth with delicate noodles, topped with menma and fish slices, garnished with shredded cabbage. Served in a floral-patterned bowl on a wooden table, the warm lighting highlights the dish’s inviting simplicity.

segments_info.text: Wooden table surface shows warm brown tones, smooth grain patterns, and subtle natural texture beneath the bowl.
The shio (salt) broth is golden-yellow, clear, and glossy, cradling thin noodles and toppings.
Menma bamboo shoots appear pale yellow, translucent, with a slightly fibrous texture and curved, segmented shape.
White ceramic bowl with colorful floral pattern along rim, smooth glossy surface, circular shape.
